overall_goal: Stir the curry to submerge the vegetables and allow it to boil

goals.description: Perform initial stirring of the pot and manage the lid
goals.rationale: The person stirs the pot with a fork, replaces the lid, and later removes the lid to stir the contents again.
The person repeatedly stirs the pot with a fork and returns the fork to the bowl to ensure the vegetables remain submerged.
